dedupe_keys.name: energy consumption curves of 499 customers from spain hourly load profiles with regional weather fraunhofer iis eas

description: A Fordatis tabular dataset of hourly electricity consumption for 499 customers in Spain, prepared to support consumption forecasting for energy retailers. Contents: three Excel files, the consumption curves of the 499 customers as hourly time series (21 MB), a profiles file describing the customers (19 kB) and hourly outside-temperature series for the customers' regions (18 MB); the keywords name private households and different customer profiles. Producer: Fraunhofer IIS EAS, funded by the German transport and digital infrastructure ministry (BMVI) under the Fraunhofer energy technologies and climate protection alliance. Coverage: customers in Spain, 2020 file dates. Format and access: XLSX downloads from the Fordatis repository (DOI 10.24406/fordatis/142), published 6 August 2021; free. Licence: a Creative Commons licence, given as CC BY 4.0 on the Papers with Code archive entry. Caveats: customer locations are only given by region and no network topology is included. Simulation uses: household load profile inputs for distribution grid, demand response and energy retail forecasting models. Related records: none identified.
